description:
This was given to me by a friend, who received it from a mentor. I can’t take credit but ask these 4 questions to find your purpose:

1. What are you running from? (Bad habits, insecurities, emotions, trauma, vices)

2. Who are you running with? (Supportive friends, people you may need to cut off, family members, mentors etc.)

3. Where are you running to? (My biggest dreams, goals, life: GET DETAILED - the more the better)

and lastly…

Why are you running in the first place?
(What’s the reason I WANT to do this exercise, why do I have my goals, what am I trying to provide, 

thank you for this @billygartonjr
transcript: Watch this if you journal. I was given a prompt by a friend and today it took about 30 seconds and it changed my life. This journal exercise is to find your purpose. It's a big word that everybody likes to use these days. But what you're going to do is write three things down. I'm going to give them to you and it will hopefully get you more clear on what you're here on this planet to do. First thing you're going to write down is, what am I running from? Second, who am I running with? Thirdly, where am I running to? They give you enough space to write. And the fourth one is why am I running in the first place? What you're running from is typically vices. Who you're running with is the people that are either no longer serving you or serving you in your mission. Where you're running to, your biggest goals, dreams, desires, the life you want, get as detailed as possible. And why am I running? Why? Why do I want all this in the first place? Take your time and write down everything as much detail as you want. And hopefully it should be about two or three pages. Come back and this will change for you. Take accountability for being you.
